research_question: Do sourced rule descriptions improve authority retrieval and subsequent legal analysis, when final models see only selected originals?
scope: Delhi Rent Control s14(1)(b) and company/banking amalgamation or statutory tenancy succession as the actual disputed ground; no general third-party subletting substitutions.

retrieval.B: BM25 original20 + rule20, dedup underlying legal units before RRF k60
retrieval.unknown_scope_or_version: retain flagged; no inferred legal compatibility

source_views: Exact stable IDs; only balanced unambiguous citation wrappers removed; cross-line requires contiguous original provenance; character maps retained.
final_contract: outcome/grounds/reason; point/case_refs/law_refs/assessment/explanation; complete JSON and required field types are hard, length/count suggestions only warnings. assessment concerns point, not eviction polarity.
examples: Same two complete fictional final_v9 examples; not target evidence.
answer_isolation: No target final reasoning/result, reference, earlier output, checks or RuleCards in final input; whole necessary allowed narrative plus prior-court status kept.
evaluation: 3-5 decisive source points per eligible case before generation; once concentrated model-assisted source review, at most3 decisive discrepancies, omissions inspected; no human gold or accuracy ranking.
failure: Single technical failure null, independent tasks continue; substantive material error stops batch; no answer repair or hindsight retrieval tuning.
freeze: Sources, library, prompts, schema, ordering, code, actual protocol frozen before any generation.
stop: No confirmed new target after bounded availability work: deliver preparation and obstacle report, no old-answer reruns. No automatic next round, commit or push.
